Mr. J. L. Johnson May 10, 1976 Page 3
a. April 19-21, 1976: Release 4,000 cubic feet per second (cfs) each day between the hours of 6 a.m. and 8 p.m. (14 hours).
b. April 22-24, 1976: Release 9,000 cfs each day between the hours of 6 a.m. and 8 p.m. (14 hours).
c. April 26-28, 1976: Release 4,000 cfs each day between the hours of 6 a.m. and 12 m. (6 hours).
d. April 29  May 1, 1976: Release 9,000 cfs each day between the hours of 6 a.m. (6 hours).
e. During the 12-day test period, about 64,000 acre-feet would be released from Amistad to Falcon Reservoirs.
The TWRC staff believes the results of the above-described simulated release test should be analyzed carefully and the analysis made an integral part of the Environmental Impact Statement.
We trust that the foregoing comments will be of assistance to you. Please let us know if we can be of further assistance. If you have any questions on IBWC-TWRC coordination matters, please notify Mr. Robert M. Whitenton, Interstate Compacts Coordinator, TWRC (Phone: 512-475-4314); if you have any questions on environmental sciences matters and on the review of Federal water resources projects affecting TWRC, notify Dr. Alfred J. D'Arezzo, Analyst for Environment and Interagency Coordination, TWRC (Phone: 512-475-2678).
Very truly yours,
TEXAS WATER RIGHTS COMMISSION
Robert E. Schneider Executive Director
